title.zh: 卷五十三 列傳第二十三 愍懷太子

proposal.before: Dan escorted Crown Princess Wang and three imperial grandsons to Jinyong with armed guards, interrogated Consort-in-chief Xie and heir guardian Jiang Jun to death.
proposal.after: Dan sent armed guards to escort Crown Princess Wang and the three imperial grandsons to Jinyong City; Consort Xie and Jiang Jun, a baolin of the crown prince, were interrogated to death.
proposal.reason: Source-backed proposed correction; independently reviewed in separate retained research. The decision scaffold is intentionally blank pending production-seal review.

context.zh: 於是使尚書和郁持節，解結為副，及大將軍梁王肜、鎮東將軍淮南王允、前將軍東武公澹、趙王倫、太保何劭詣東宮，廢太子為庶人。
context.idiomatic: Thereupon Minister Director He Yu was dispatched with insignia, with Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Sima Rong, Prince of Liang; Eastern Garrison General Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan; Forward General Sima Dan, Eastern Martial Duke; Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao; and Grand Guardian He Shao. They went to the Eastern Palace to depose the Crown Prince as a commoner.
context.literal: Thereupon Minister Director He Yu was dispatched with insignia, Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Rong, Prince of Liang, Eastern Garrison General Yun, Prince of Huainan, Forward General Eastern Martial Duke Dan, Lun, Prince of Zhao, and Grand Guardian He Shao to the Eastern Palace to depose the crown prince as commoner.

context.zh: 是日太子游玄圃，聞有使者至，改服出崇賢門，再拜受詔，步出承華門，乘粗犢車。
context.idiomatic: Yu took the edict from the garden and rode an ox-cart out.
context.literal: That day the crown prince roamed the Mystic Garden; hearing envoys arrived he changed clothes, exited Chongxian Gate, twice bowed receiving the edict, walked out Chenghua Gate, and rode a rough ox-cart.

context.zh: 澹以兵仗送太子妃王氏、三皇孫于金墉城，考竟謝淑妃及太子保林蔣俊。
context.idiomatic: Dan marched Wang consort and grandsons to Jinyong—executed Xie and Jiang Jun.
context.literal: Dan escorted Crown Princess Wang and three imperial grandsons to Jinyong with armed guards, interrogated Consort-in-chief Xie and heir guardian Jiang Jun to death.

context.zh: 明年正月，賈后又使黃門自首，欲與太子為逆。
context.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, Empress Jia again had a Yellow Gate attendant confess that he intended to rebel with the crown prince.
context.literal: The next first month Empress Jia again had a Yellow Gate confess plotting rebellion with the crown prince.

context.zh: 詔以黃門首辭班示公卿。
context.idiomatic: An edict circulated the attendant's confession among the dukes and ministers.
context.literal: An edict circulated the confession among dukes and ministers.

context.zh: 維爾少資岐嶷之質，荷先帝殊異之寵，大啟土宇，奄有淮陵。
context.idiomatic: Hui's ghost-eulogy praised Wu Di's love and Yu's fief.
context.literal: In youth you bore a nature quick and wise; the late emperor gave you exceptional favor, opening great territory, holding Hailing.

context.idiomatic: In obedience to his final command, I established you as heir apparent, to bring glory to our ancestors.
